mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_product_skus(product_id,merchant_id,code,spec_key,specifications,default_sku,stock_product_id) SELECT p.id,p.merchant_id,CONCAT('DEFAULT-',p.id),SHA2('{}',256),'{}',TRUE,p.id FROM products p LEFT JOIN catalog_product_skus s ON s.default_product_id=p.id WHERE p.listing_product_id IS NULL AND s.id IS NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_version=catalog_product_skus.business_version

INSERT INTO catalog_product_skus(product_id,merchant_id,code,spec_key,specifications,default_sku,stock_product_id) VALUES (#{product},#{merchant},CONCAT('DEFAULT-',#{product}),SHA2('{}',256),'{}',TRUE,#{product}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE business_version=catalog_product_skus.business_version

INSERT INTO catalog_product_skus(product_id,merchant_id,code,spec_key,specifications,default_sku,stock_product_id) SELECT p.id,p.merchant_id,CONCAT('DEFAULT-',p.id),encode(sha256(convert_to('{}','UTF8')),'hex'),'{}',TRUE,p.id FROM products p LEFT JOIN catalog_product_skus s ON s.default_product_id=p.id WHERE p.listing_product_id IS NULL AND s.id IS NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO catalog_product_skus(product_id,merchant_id,code,spec_key,specifications,default_sku,stock_product_id) VALUES (#{product},#{merchant},CONCAT('DEFAULT-',#{product}), encode(sha256(convert_to('{}','UTF8')),'hex'),'{}',TRUE,#{product}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE merchant_id=#{merchant} AND product_id=#{product} ORDER BY default_sku DESC,id
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE merchant_id=#{merchant} AND product_id=#{product} AND id=#{sku}
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE merchant_id=#{merchant} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE default_sku=FALSE AND stock_product_id IS NULL ORDER BY product_id,id LIMIT 25
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE default_sku=FALSE AND stock_product_id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE default_sku=FALSE AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' AND stock_product_id IS NOT NULL AND product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY product_id,id
SELECT FROM catalog_product_skus WHERE default_sku=TRUE AND stock_product_id IS NOT NULL AND JSON_LENGTH(specifications)>0 AND product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY product_id
mapper.update: UPDATE catalog_product_skus SET stock_product_id=#{stockProductId} WHERE id=#{sku} AND stock_product_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO catalog_product_skus(product_id,merchant_id,code,spec_key,specifications,default_sku, unit_price,lifecycle_status,request_id,create_fingerprint) VALUES (#{productId},#{merchantId},#{code},#{specKey},CAST(#{specifications} AS jsonb),FALSE, #{unitPrice},#{lifecycleStatus},#{requestId},#{createFingerprint}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
